Standard.Name: AudioText Play_residents_6607250: By Allah! Lend us your support!
AudioText Play_residents_6607251: Will you stand by me?
AudioText Play_residents_6607252: I humbly request your help!
AudioText Play_residents_6607253: I am appealing to you for support!
AudioText Play_residents_6607260: You surely wouldn't leave me in the lurch?
AudioText Play_residents_6607261: Is there still hope for our cause?
AudioText Play_residents_6607270: Have you truly taken such efforts on my behalf?
AudioText Play_residents_6607271: My request... Have you actually fulfilled it?
AudioText Play_residents_6607280: Then maybe later, inshallah!
AudioText Play_residents_6607281: I am still pinning my hopes on you...
AudioText Play_residents_6607290: May Allah bless you for your help!
AudioText Play_residents_6607291: We are all greatly indebted to you...
AudioText Play_residents_6607300: It seems Allah has something else in mind...
AudioText Play_residents_6607301: Such a shame it has to end this way...
AudioText Play_residents_6607310: The desert is paradise compared to this Settlement!
AudioText Play_residents_6607311: By Allah! I can't take another day here!
AudioText Play_residents_6607312: I'm going to put my Tent up somewhere else...
AudioText Play_residents_6607313: Nomads will move out if they are unsatisfied…
AudioText Play_residents_6607314: Do you realise that we've never been so uncomfortable!?
AudioText Play_residents_6607320: By Allah! How about these for lean times…?!
AudioText Play_residents_6607321: What did we do to displease Allah so much?!
AudioText Play_residents_6607322: Even the Desert is more hospitable than this City!
AudioText Play_residents_6607323: The People are unhappy with life in this City!
AudioText Play_residents_6607324: I pray to Allah that good times will soon follow the bad...
AudioText Play_residents_6607330: We are but simple Nomads. We don't need much...
AudioText Play_residents_6607331: You were right! It IS better to live here than to move from Town to Town...
AudioText Play_residents_6607332: What could we want besides Food and water for ourselves and our Camels?!
AudioText Play_residents_6607333: Life has changed somewhat since we have been here… but it is good.
AudioText Play_residents_6607334: You can actually get used to life in a House built of Stone…
AudioText Play_residents_6607340: Is there anything finer than sitting in the shade eating Dates?
AudioText Play_residents_6607341: I sold loads of Camels at the bazaar today!
AudioText Play_residents_6607342: Allah is smiling down on this City!
AudioText Play_residents_6607343: I would never have thought that life would be so comfortable here…
AudioText Play_residents_6607344: I don't regret giving up the Nomad life!
AudioText Play_residents_6607350: Allah has heard my prayers! We are enjoying a better life than ever before!
AudioText Play_residents_6607351: An oasis of Peace and prosperity in the middle of the Desert… Allah be praised!
AudioText Play_residents_6607352: Since I came to live here, I've learnt the meaning of the word 'home'!
AudioText Play_residents_6607353: My family and I are truly thankful that we can live here completely free of worry!
AudioText Play_residents_6607354: We have all been blessed by Allah!
